_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Mass Properties Control and Management Process (MPCMP) Report
summary: The MPCMP Report provides visibility and control of the contractor's intent, approach, and methods used to optimize mass properties, enabling efficient communications between the contractor, vendor, user, and acquiring agency.
use_relationship:
The Mass Properties Control and Management Process (MPCMP) Report will provide visibility and control of the contractor's intent, approach, and methods employed to optimize the mass properties of the product. The report shall provide for maximum efficient communications between the contractor, vendor, user, and acquiring agency.
a. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
b. DI-MGMT-81452A supersedes DI-MGMT-84152.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revision, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The MPCMP Report shall be in the contractor's format. A suggested format is provided (see 3.4 below).

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following:

children.title: The report shall depict the elements of a program for monitoring, controlling, and validating mass properties to insure the purchase of minimum weight air vehicles allowable.
The report shall include scheduling information to show the integration of major mass properties tasks with the major program milestones.
Revisions to the original report shall reflect any program changes.
